rationale.campaign_length: 结构化库直接定位40项U39任务实体，包含互斥分支。
rationale.colonization: 伊菲莱与南阿尔特兰的未殖民土地、殖民者问题进入任务，但不是单纯殖民经济国。
rationale.complexity: 宗教改革与形成条件、派系忠诚、战争和条件分支叠加。
rationale.dark_story: 奴役、屠杀、刺杀、复仇及末日路线均在叙事中出现。
rationale.difficulty: 形成门槛与跨地区战争均较重；实际平衡未实测。
rationale.diplomacy: 议会派系、先驱者关系和被解放者处置需要政治选择。
rationale.early_pressure: U39不是1444开局国；形成要求泰琴德发展度和大面积信仰改革。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 法师塔、战斗法师学院和大型魔法仪式是显著后期门槛。
rationale.narrative_density: 银刺、三派系议会、革命、复仇与终局形成连贯长篇故事。
rationale.tall_play: 形成门槛有高开发度，后续亦有机构与魔法项目建设，但主轴是远征。
rationale.trade_economy: 任务涉及糖业和奴役经济重组，贸易不是主要独特机制。
rationale.warfare: 任务从泰琴德延伸至伊菲莱、洇河和更广区域，征服与解放战争贯穿主线。

identity.appearance: 1444年未查到拥有U39的省份；奥伦·纳伊鲁改革宗教并满足泰琴德开发度、信仰覆盖等条件后由决议形成
identity.formation_scope: 符合宗教及决议条件的国家均可形成；不是唯一固定前身
identity.region: Taychend / South Aelantir（泰琴德／南阿尔特兰）

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
来到此地的贾赫的典范虽然与维伦纳尔崇拜有着相同的废奴理念，但同时也带来了除了最后之神外，伟大诸神都已逝去的沉重消息。维伦纳尔崇拜者立刻意识到，他们不能再仅仅等待邪恶自行毁灭，而是必须亲自去实现。最后一位隐世诸神，纳伊鲁已经向泰琴德发出了新时代的信号，但只有维伦纳尔崇拜者才能去创造新时代。于是，奥伦纳伊鲁，即独一烈阳，诞生了。

从此，独一烈阳迅速陷入激进主义的漩涡，它抨击君主制、暴政、外国侵略者，尤其是奴隶制。独一烈阳主张对社会进行革命性改造，以军阀祭司卡瓦拉尔为矛尖，为哈兰上的每一个生命带来黎明——将众生从黑暗中解放出来。这种宗教狂热驱动着卡瓦拉尔乃至整个信仰，而独一烈阳绝不会放弃向每一个倾听者传教。
description.text_en:
When the Jaherian Exemplars arrived, sharing the Cult of Vherenar’s abolitionist beliefs but also bringing the dark news of the death of all but one of the Great-Gods, the Cult of Vherenar knew instantly that they could not simply wait for the destruction of evil, but must bring it about themselves. The last of the Elusive Ones, Nayiru, had sent Taychend the heralds of a new age, but the Cult of Vherenar alone could bring it about. And so the Oren Nayiru were born, the Cult of the One Sun.

From there, their religion quickly descended into a spiral of radicalism, railing against monarchy, tyranny, foreign invaders, and above all slavery. The Oren Nayiru advocated a revolutionary transformation of society, with the Kavalali, warlord-priests, as the tip of the spear that would bring the Coming of the Dawn – liberation from darkness – to every living being on the planet. This religious fervour would drive the Kavalali and the faith as a whole, and the Oren Nayiru would never give up proselytising its message to everyone who could hear it.

description.text:
只有暴君才会独自统治。虽然卡瓦拉尔在自己的社区中被信任为政治和精神事务的领导者，而高阶卡瓦拉尔则被视为覆盖一整片地区的社区们的统治者，但独一烈阳一直认为，必须有某种信仰范围内的机构来控制其成员的行动，从而引导独一烈阳朝着真正的方向前进。受南方城市类似元老院的瓦尔哈蒂库塔（「大权力之环」）和加拉文德战士古老的潘塔库塔姆（「广泛集会」）的启发，一个新的机构诞生了——卡瓦拉库塔姆，即「卡拉瓦尔环会」。

最初，卡瓦拉库塔姆只是一个非正式机构，本质上它是一个「信函政府」，通过高阶卡瓦拉尔之间的地下通信网络，独一烈阳的领导人们不断质疑和辩论彼此的宗教立场和政治行动，以督促彼此做到最好。黎明到来后，信徒希望这个非正式网络能迅速转变为一个单一的正式立法机构。在卡瓦拉库塔姆的大厅里，任何声音都不会受到束缚，信仰的各个角落都有代表自己的卡瓦拉尔，重大决策则由自由投票决定。
description.text_en:
Only a tyrant rules alone. Though individual Kavalali are trusted in their own communities to lead in political and spiritual matters, and the High Kavalali are trusted to rule over their cells’ area of control, the Oren Nayiru had always believed that there must be some sort of faith-wide body that controlled the actions of its members, and therefore guided the Oren Nayiru in the true direction. Inspired by the senate-like Valhathikutta of the southern cities, and the ancient Pantacuttam (“wide gatherings”) of Kalavendhi warriors, a new body was born - the Kavalakuttam, the “Circle of Kalavali”.

Originally, the Kavalakuttam was an informal institution, essentially a “government of letters”. Carried along the underground network of communication between the High Kavalali, the leaders of the Oren Nayiru constantly challenged and debated each other’s religious positions and political actions, aiming to hold each other to account as best they could. After the arrival of Dawn, it was hoped the transformation of this informal network to a single formal legislature would be swift and painless. Within the halls of the Kavalakuttam, no voice would be shackled, and Kavalali from every corner of the faith would be represented, freely voting on decisions of importance.

description.text:
在卡瓦拉尔看来，役奴贵族的遗物在过去的1500年里已将其邪恶本质暴露无遗，军阀们利用遗物将暴政和帝国强加给人民，权力之下是数不清的被压迫者。而这种观点与安得俄斯哲学流传的魔法首先且主要发源于生命体的信条相结合，遗物的精灵性学说便自然而然地产生了。神话和考古学都清楚地告诉我们，役奴贵族的权力来自于对他人的奴役——那么，认为他们将魔法力量灌注给遗物也同样是一种奴役，又怎么会是牵强之事呢？

独一烈阳认为遗物是，且必须，被作为拥有灵魂之物去对待。尽管有必要像使用约丹盔甲一样使用遗物来捍卫和促进信仰，但不能忘记它们被创造时的不道德本质。独一烈阳需要以最尊重的态度对待遗物，因此必须打击新的所谓科学的奇械术以及与之相关的遗物贸易。
description.text_en:
From the perspective of the Kavalali, the relics of the Slaver-Nobles had made their evil clear over the past 1500 years, as warlords used them to impose tyrannical regimes and empires on the people, and untold millions were crushed beneath their power. When combined with the belief, widespread in Andeiosian philosophy, that magic originates first and foremost from living beings, the doctrine of the Elvenness of Relics came naturally. The Slaver-Nobles, as myth and archaeology tell plainly, built their power from the slavery of others – would it be that far-fetched, then, to say that the magical force they imbued their relics with came from slavery as well?

The Oren Nayiru believe that relics are ensouled objects, and must be treated as such. Though it may be necessary, as it was with the Armour of Yodhan, to wield them in the defence and advancement of the faith, the immoral nature of their creation cannot be forgotten. To the Oren Nayiru relics must be treated with the utmost respect, and both the new so-called-science of Artificery, and the foreign relic-trade intertwined with it, must be cracked down on.

description.text:
没有阿墨翁纪律严明的军队，也没有军阀们依仗的遗物，难怪卡瓦拉尔会转向通过来自东方的新希望——火药来巩固权力。最初由雷赞坎德提供武器的独一烈阳信徒在火绳枪武器上投入了大量资金，很快学会了如何制造自己的火枪，并建立了精锐的「火绳枪旗兵」，他们将在战场上挥舞纳伊鲁的力量化身。对于独一烈阳来说，火绳枪等火枪很快就成为了伟大的后发先至之力，终有一天会将他们带向黎明。

这些火绳枪部队构成了独一烈阳战场战术的脊梁，但它们只是更大的整体——长矛的杆身——中的一部分。无论是伏击行军纵队，还是在战场上攻击敌军阵线，独一烈阳的战术大致相同——先用毁灭性的齐射削弱敌军阵线，扰乱他们的队形，瓦解他们的斗志。然后，其余步兵手持长矛和马刀，在卡瓦拉尔的带领下从正面发起冲锋。如果敌人没有在接战时被击溃，也往往难敌独一烈阳信徒的狂热坚韧，因为他们会不计伤亡地向前冲锋，用鲜血换取黎明。
description.text_en:
Without the disciplined military might Ameion enjoyed, or the relics of the warlords to help them, it was no wonder that the Kavalali would turn to a new hope from the east to secure their power – gunpowder. Armed originally by Rezankand, the Oren Nayiru invested significantly into matchlock weaponry, quickly learning how to build their own gunsmithies and establishing elite “Matchlock Banners”, who would wield the concentrated power of Nayiru on the battlefield. To the Oren Nayiru, the matchlock and musket quickly became a great equaliser that would one day carry them to dawn.

These matchlock troops form the spine of the Oren Nayiru’s battlefield tactics, but they are but one part of the larger whole, the shaft of the lance. Whether ambushing a marching column or assaulting enemy lines on the field, Oren Nayiru doctrine is broadly the same – withering volley fire weakens the enemy line, disrupting their formations and breaking their resolve. Then the rest of the infantry charge, armed with spear and sabre and led from the front by the Kavalali. If the enemy do not break on contact, they often fall regardless to the zealous tenacity of their enemy, as the Oren Nayiru press forwards without regard for casualties, giving their blood for Dawn.

name.text_en: Flash in the Barrel, Light in the Dark

description.text:
「当我们崛起并征服世界时，黑暗也就结束了，就像烈阳征服黑夜一样。」埃兰达尔「银怨」如此说道，他向日蚀举起了剑，开始了伟大的黎明之战。独一烈阳的大哨兵派追随着银怨的脚步，相信只有一个强大有力的士兵皇帝，从前线领导着信仰，才能展开必要的全球征服，最终结束军阀割据的循环，将纳伊鲁之光带给世界其他地方。

大哨兵派以韦斯雷努为中心，在普通士兵中找到了自己的支持者，他们不断向高阶卡瓦拉尔施压，要求高阶卡瓦拉尔放弃相对保守的温和作风——如果他们能如愿以偿，独一烈阳信仰将完全军事化，卡瓦拉尔环会则会被排挤到一边，高阶卡瓦拉尔与大哨兵之间的关系也会被重新定义为对后者有利。毕竟，卡瓦拉尔们不是说过吗，对于世界上已经存在的军阀和暴君来说，还有什么比我们自己培养出来的冠军更大的挑战呢？
description.text_en:
“The darkness ends when we rise and conquer the world, as sun conquers night.” So said Elrandar Silverspite, as he raised his sword to the Eclipse and began the great war for Dawn. The Kamrayakvalist faction of the Oren Nayiru follow in Silverspite’s footsteps, believing that only a strong, powerful Soldier-Emperor, leading the faith from the front lines, can embark on the global conquest necessary to finally end the cycle of warlordism and bring Nayiru’s light to the rest of the world.

The Kamrayakvalists, centred in Uesrennu, find their support among the rank-and-file soldiery, who are constantly pressuring the High Kavalali to throw off their comparatively conservative moderatism – if they could have it their way, they would see the faith totally militarised, the Kavalakuttam sidelined, and the relationship between High Kavalali and Kamrayakval redefined in the latter’s favour. After all, as the Kavalalists say, what better challenge to the pre-existing warlords and tyrants of the world could there be, than to raise up a champion of our own?

description.text:
高阶卡瓦拉尔精英们一直认为，让独一烈阳走上真正的道路是他们的宗教职责，也是他们的政治责任。虽然他们曾经是导致该信仰陷入激进主义的主要推手，但在15世纪后半叶，当独一烈阳的方向和信仰得到巩固后，几次挫折和挑战促使高阶卡瓦拉尔们将运动的内部稳定置于快速扩张和革命之上。

当银怨将信仰引向灾难时，因卷入他的嗜血妄想而饱受摧残的高阶卡瓦拉尔们决定采取挽救的行动。高阶卡瓦拉尔的权力集中在大纳加尔的三个区域中，他们的支持来自于所有致力于革命但又不愿投身于疯狂的军国主义绞肉机的人，他们主张对内和对外都保持温和，希望在避免国内混乱的同时也不忽视世界其他地区的困境。
description.text_en:
The elite High Kavalali have always considered it their sacred duty to keep the Oren Nayiru on the true path, and the High Kavalalist faction believes it is their political duty as well. Though they were once the primary drivers of the faith’s descent into radicalism, once the Oren Nayiru’s direction and beliefs solidified by in the latter half 15th century, several setbacks and challenges drove the High Kavalali to place the internal stability of the movement over rapid expansion and revolution.

When Silverspite led the faith to disaster, it would be the High Kavalali, brutalised by his descent into bloodthirsty paranoia, that would act to save it. With their power centred in the Three Cells of Nanru Nakar, and support drawn from any committed to revolution but unwilling to throw their bodies to the meatgrinder of militaristic madness, the High Kavalalists advocate moderation at home and abroad, hoping to prevent internal chaos while not neglecting the woes of the rest of the world.

name.text_en: Keepers of Truth, Guide Our Way

description.text:
当埃兰达尔「银怨」开始他的黎明之战时，独一烈阳中的许多人相信，不可避免的最终胜利将至。一次又一次的胜利让他们信心倍增，即使死亡人数和破坏程度几乎达到了难以承受的程度。然后，银怨陷入了疯狂，然后，他倒在了战场上，而独一烈阳的残余势力逃回了阴影之中。八百万人死亡，信仰分崩离析，剩下的人终于明白一切都白费了。在接下来的岁月里，许多信徒开始批判肆虐的军国主义狂热，这种狂热已经吞噬了独一烈阳——因此修道院派完全摒弃了这种狂热。

修道院派主要居住在铁丘和拉兰卡尔高地的山顶据点之中，他们认为没有必要发动任何疯狂的扩张主义战争——相反，独一烈阳信徒可以在已经拥有的土地上建造纳伊鲁的天堂，等待纳伊鲁在未来某个不确定的时间真正的回归。这样，信仰之光就能得以保存，而不会像银怨那样招致死亡和破坏。在卡拉瓦尔环会中，修道院派始终主张克制、内部发展和防御姿态。
description.text_en:
When Elrandar Silverspite began his War for the Dawn, many among the Oren Nayiru believed that their inevitable victory was finally drawing near. Victory after victory emboldened them, even as the death toll and devastation reached nearly unbearable levels. Then Silverspite fell to madness, and then he fell in battle, and as the remnants of the Oren Nayiru fled back to the shadows. With eight million dead and the faith shattered, they knew it was all for nothing. In the following years, many took aim at the rampant militaristic fervour that had consumed the Oren Nayiru – and so the Monasticists rejected it entirely.

Taking up residence primarily in the hilltop strongholds of the Iron Hills and the Larankarha Highlands, the Monasticists believe that there is no need to launch any wild, expansionist wars – instead, one can build Nayiru’s paradise in the lands the faith already owns, awaiting Nayiru’s true return at some indeterminate time in the future. This way, the light of the faith can be preserved, without inviting death and devastation like Silverspite did. In the wider Kavalakuttam, the Monasticists argue always for restraint, internal development and a defensive posture.

player_overview.how_it_plays: 先整合泰琴德并改革奥伦·纳伊鲁宗教，形成U39；随后兼顾议会派系、宗教战争、跨海远征与高阶魔法项目。
player_overview.overview: 奥伦瓦利亚姆是泰琴德的反奴役形成国，不是1444开局国。达成宗教改革和大规模地区控制后，你将进入带三派系议会的神权民主，向奴隶主与殖民者发动解放战争。它有很长的任务树、角色命运与魔法工程，结尾会追问：解放他人时，是承认他们的选择，还是以复仇和强制改造取代旧统治？
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢革命故事、形成国挑战、庞大任务树、法师工程和有争议的终局选择的玩家。
signature_features: 高门槛形成后开启40个直接任务实体组成的长篇战役，含条件分支。

values.rationale: 废奴、土地与被奴役者的主体性构成明确公共利益；神权议会和某些被解放者选择也支持较高尊严分。但强制改宗、文化改造、省份破坏、刺杀和复仇修正有本地脚本依据，严重削弱克制。路线可分叉，主体分数取混合而非把最佳或最坏结局当必然。扩张、魔法、宗教本身不作为善恶依据。
red_flags: 事件可强制改变被征服地区文化和宗教并造成破坏
复仇分支可对特定人群采取报复性政策
